title: Kwesi Adofo-Mensah returns to 49ers as a personnel executive

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kwesi Adofo-Mensah returns to 49ers as a personnel executive
sources.description: Former Vikings General Manager Kwesi Adofo-Mensah has found a new job. 49ers General Manager John Lynch said at a Tuesday press conference that Adofo-Mensah is joining the team as a personnel executive.
